purpose: Freeze the required executor behavior before any outcome, settlement, realized return, or ARGOS PnL read is permitted.

allowed_reads: calendar metadata without realized return calculation
mode_validate_only.required_output: PASS/FAIL validation and deterministic missing-input report

mode_materialize_eligibility.description: Build N_final_backtestable candidates by deterministic joins only. Eligibility failures must be retained with reason codes.

mode_execute_economic_backtest.description: Only after protocol and executor freezes pass, read prices/benchmark and compute pre-specified market-adjusted net opportunity returns.

required_assertions: The executor must fail closed if the protocol freeze is missing or stale.
The executor must fail closed if the full expansion result freeze is missing or stale.
The executor must fail closed if any output attempts to summarize returns before execution authorization.
The executor must emit exact counts for included and excluded opportunities.
The executor must encode no-trade as zero return per eligible opportunity, not as row deletion.
The executor must preserve negative, null and no-trade results as reportable outcomes.
next_required_artifact: execution authorization that names the concrete executor script/blob SHA and explicitly permits eligibility materialization and economic backtest execution under this frozen protocol
